emailThread: Warehouse team at Bhiwandi facility says materials were not accepted at the receiving dock due to missing packing slip. Until inward entry is logged in ERP, payment cannot be initiated.
disputeNotes: Dock supervisor rejected unmanifested pallet load.

emailThread: Physical count at gate 3 is pending because your driver unloaded after 6 PM. Our security supervisor hasn't signed off on the inbound manifest yet.
disputeNotes: Gate security signoff pending on evening delivery.

emailThread: Stock intake register does not show these cartons. Please coordinate with logistics to get the intake memo validated so we can process the wire.
disputeNotes: Intake register mismatch with warehouse manifest.

emailThread: Bhaiya, warehouse manager bol raha hai ki boxes receive hi nahi hue. Unloading verification slip bhej do, tabhi vendor release hoga.
disputeNotes: Hinglish communication from godown manager.

emailThread: We searched our shared finance mailbox and found zero emails from your domain for June billing. Could you attach the PDF billing document directly in this thread?
disputeNotes: Mailbox search yielded zero results for vendor domain.

emailThread: Our centralized accounting portal has no bill on file for this billing cycle. Please email the tax document along with your GSTIN certificate to our treasury desk.
disputeNotes: Portal missing tax filing attachment.

emailThread: The previous attachment was a corrupt 0-byte file that our antivirus quarantined. Kindly re-attach a fresh PDF copy so our team can punch it in.
disputeNotes: Quarantined email attachment.

emailThread: Mail bounce hua hoga aapka shayad, humare records me bill nahi dikh raha hai. Ek baar accounts desk ko copy forward kar dijiye.
disputeNotes: Bounced email explanation in Hinglish.

emailThread: The VP of Marketing is currently on international leave until Monday. Her digital signature is the final requirement for the payment release.
disputeNotes: Pending VP executive authorization.

emailThread: The bill has passed initial audit and is currently parked in the department head's pending authorization tray. We will release RTGS as soon as he logs in.
disputeNotes: Parked in manager authorization tray.

emailThread: We are waiting on the regional director to clear his internal portal backlog before finance can generate the disbursement batch.
disputeNotes: Director portal backlog delay.

emailThread: Sirji, bill verify ho chuka hai, bas senior management ka sign-off bacha hai. Unke desk se pass hote hi NEFT kar denge.
disputeNotes: Awaiting senior management signoff in Hinglish.

emailThread: Your quote clearly agreed on 450 per unit, but the billing states 520 per unit across all 200 pieces. We are holding the billing until an adjusted debit adjustment is passed.
disputeNotes: Unit price variance against approved master quote.

emailThread: Our inspection team only counted 84 working units instead of the billed 100. We will pay for the 84 accepted pieces once the revised breakdown is provided.
disputeNotes: Partial delivery defect short-count.

emailThread: You billed 18% IGST instead of 5% CGST/SGST for intrastate supply within Maharashtra. Correct the tax calculation and issue an amended voucher.
disputeNotes: GST tax slab mismatch on intrastate delivery.

emailThread: Billed charges me pricing galat lagayi hai, agreed price se 15% zyada hai. Pehle correct bill ya adjusted voucher bhejo tabhi balance release hoga.
disputeNotes: Price discrepancy dispute in Hinglish.

emailThread: We had a delayed receivable cycle from our hospital clients this quarter and our treasury funds are exhausted. Would it be acceptable to wire 30% this Friday and the rest on the 25th?
disputeNotes: Requesting staggered settlement due to client receivables delay.

emailThread: Our working capital limits are exhausted with SBI until our next trade loan sanction next fortnight. We request your patience for 10 banking days.
disputeNotes: Awaiting SBI trade credit line renewal.

emailThread: Due to slow recoveries from market distributors, our operational bank account has insufficient balance to honor the full amount today. Can we pay in two tranches?
disputeNotes: Insufficient bank balance requesting two tranches.

emailThread: Is mahine humari market payments phasi hui hain, bank account me fund balance tight hai. Thoda samay de dijiye ya staggered schedule bana dijiye.
disputeNotes: Market payments delay request in Hinglish.

emailThread: Thanks for the reminder. This has been queued for our standard Friday vendor payout run. You should receive the UTR number shortly.
disputeNotes: Scheduled for routine Friday payout batch.

emailThread: Payment run was delayed due to month-end bank reconciliation. It is lined up for batch processing tomorrow morning.
disputeNotes: Month-end reconciliation processing delay.

emailThread: Our vendor banking cycle runs on the 10th and 25th of every month. Your payment will be remitted in the upcoming cycle.
disputeNotes: Fortnightly scheduled vendor cycle.

emailThread: Payment schedule me lined up hai. Monday ko treasury batch execute hoga to UTR update ho jayega.
disputeNotes: Upcoming Monday treasury run in Hinglish.
